lines.zh: 我的脚步把地面烤出裂纹。
lines.en: My steps crack the ground with heat.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印在焦土里冒起白烟。
lines.en: My hoofprints give off white smoke in the scorched soil.

lines.zh: 余烬在剑上烧着，我等着对手。
lines.en: Embers burn on my blade while I wait.

lines.zh: 下界之主的将，站在这里。
lines.en: One of the Nether Lord's generals stands here.
A thread of smoke rises from my armor seams.
Lava seeps from its armor seams
It counts the names of fallen men
It stands with its back to the lava lake
It murmurs the Nether lord's decree

lines.zh: 下界之主的将，先看看你怎么打。
lines.en: A Nether lord's general watches how you fight.
Nether flame circles me and never dies.
Seems to want to swallow you

lines.zh: 我评估你，也评估你腰间的武器。
lines.en: I weigh you, and the weapon at your belt.
It eyes the weapon in your hand
It recognizes the burns on your skin

lines.zh: 炙热的火焰灼烧着我的身体。
我感到疼痛，但不能停下。
lines.en: Pain sears me, but I can't stop.

lines.zh: 我被强大的冲击击中了。
伤口在流血，我必须停下来。
我需要更多的力量来战斗。
lines.en: I need more strength to fight.

lines.zh: 你接近了它的领域，火焰开始在你周围旋转。
lines.en: You got too close to its domain; flames swirl around you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着恶意的红光，盯着你。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with malicious red, staring at you.

lines.zh: 它低吟着，火焰从它的口中喷出。
lines.en: It growls, spitting flames from its mouth.

lines.zh: 你看见它的鳞片在黑暗中反射出微光。
lines.en: You see its scales reflecting a faint light in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，准备发动攻击。
它的双臂挥舞着火焰，像是在跳舞。
lines.en: Its flaming arms dance, preparing to strike.

lines.zh: 它的叫声回荡在岩洞的每一个角落。
lines.en: Its roar echoes through every corner of the cave.

lines.zh: 你感受到了它的怒气，火焰更加炽热。
lines.en: You feel its rage; the flames grow hotter.

lines.zh: 它向你投掷了一团燃烧的石块。
lines.en: It throws a burning boulder at you.

lines.zh: 它的火焰之息几乎将你焚烧。
lines.en: Its breath of flames nearly incinerates you.

lines.zh: 你们的身体碰撞在一起，火星四溅。
它的双臂抓住了你，火焰包裹着你的身体。
lines.en: Its flaming arms grab you, wrapping you in fire.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的巨石，它用火焰将你烤干。
lines.en: You collide with its巨石, it roasts you with flames.

lines.zh: 火焰从它的触手蔓延到你的身上。
lines.en: Flames spread from its tentacles to your body.

lines.zh: 你们互相撞击，它的鳞片划破你的皮肤。
lines.en: You collide, its scales scratch your skin.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞引发了一场小型的火风暴。
lines.en: Your collision sparks a small firestorm.

lines.zh: 它的火焰之息击中了你，你感到灼热。
lines.en: Its breath of flames hits you, burning you.

lines.zh: 你们互相冲撞，它试图把你撕裂。
lines.en: You collide, it tries to tear you apart.

lines.zh: 它的身体重重地撞上了你，火焰四溅。
lines.en: Its body collides with you, flames flying.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞像是火焰和力量的对决。
lines.en: Your collision is a battle of fire and force.

lines.zh: 它与另一个冥焰诡将并肩站立，相互对视。
lines.en: It stands with another Hadean Enforcer, gazing at each other.

lines.zh: 它的火焰与同伴的融合，形成更加炽热的火焰。
lines.en: Its flames merge with its companion's, becoming hotter.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的声音，吸引着配偶的到来。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl, attracting its mate.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕在配偶身上，火焰更加明亮。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around its mate, the flames brighter.

lines.zh: 它们相互靠近，火焰从它们身上升起。
lines.en: They approach each other, flames rising from them.

lines.zh: 它们相视而笑，彼此之间火焰轻舞。
lines.en: They smile at each other, flames dancing between them.

lines.zh: 它们互相触碰，共同分享火焰的温暖。
lines.en: They touch each other, sharing the warmth of flames.

lines.zh: 它们并肩站立，火焰从它们之间交织。
lines.en: They stand side by side, flames intertwining between them.

lines.zh: 它们的火焰交织在一起，形成一个巨大的火球。
lines.en: Their flames intertwine, forming a great fireball.

lines.zh: 它们的火焰融合，象征着力量的结合。
lines.en: Their flames merge, symbolizing a union of power.
Lord of the Nether, my command!
Ice and fire blend, none can match!
Prey in sight, burn the future!
Appears in darkness, burn the soul!
Ice and fire, nowhere to run!
Of three generals, only I remain
You have stepped onto the old battlefield
The Nether lord's order still stands
Show me what your nerve is worth
Are you the one I waited for
Don't back off. It won't help

lines.zh: 熔岩在我脚边替你数着拍子。
lines.en: The lava at my feet counts the beats for you.
The lava is counting your time
I burned every span of this ground
Flame crawls through your armor's gaps
I'll turn you to ash as well
Molten fire erupts from the earth!
From the heart of the earth, Hadean Enforcer!
Deep in the earth, Hadean Enforcer!
Lord of the Nether, a general returns!
Lord of the Abyss, Hadean Enforcer!
An old general takes its place
The three generals' banner still stands
The Nether lord has not returned
I have waited long for this day
The fire must swear its oath again
Your blood will light the flame

lines.zh: 火焰吞了我的皮，下界之主的旗还没倒。
lines.en: Fire ate my skin, yet my lord's banner still stands.

lines.zh: 余烬落在肩上，我摔得不轻。
lines.en: Ember fell on my shoulder. That was a hard landing.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我的火只剩一点芯。
lines.en: Water pours on me; only a thread of fire remains.

lines.zh: 烈焰的将袍，被炸开一道。
lines.en: The blast tore a seam in my flame cloak.

lines.zh: 灰烬里没有可吃的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing to eat in the ash.

lines.zh: 虚无之力侵蚀了我的灵魂。
lines.en: Void power eats at my soul.
